title: Shaders and node setups
summary: How you build materials in the node editor: which shader you start from, procedural or image textures, the node chains you reuse (noise into roughness, normal maps, shader bevels) and your PBR values per material.

request.brief: Submit a finished asset with its materials built the way you shade for review: the full node setups, not just flat colours.
must_include: Your usual procedural or image texture setups
Any shader node groups you reuse
ideas: a prop with painted metal, rubber and glass

questions.ask: Anything about how you shade that the node trees don't show (for example: final textures come from Substance)?
